news.impact: Murray has struggled to make an impact behind center early in the season for head coach Kevin O'Connell, passing for less than 250 yards in each of his four contests. The dual-threat signal caller remains difficult for fantasy managers to trust as the Vikings enter their bye week.

news.body: Kyler Murray completed 27-of-37 passing attempts for 247 yards in Sunday's 15-10 win over the Miami Dolphins.
news.head: Kyler Murray scoreless in win Sunday
news.impact: Murray took care of the ball on Sunday, but he wasn't able to get much going against the Dolphins and didn't score a touchdown during the team's win. He shouldn't be considered a good fantasy option moving forward, especially if Justin Jefferson (ankle) has to miss more time.

news.body: Kyler Murray completed 15-of-29 passes for 168 yards with one touchdown and one interception in the Vikings 23-16 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday.
news.head: Kyler Murray has underwhelming day Sunday
news.impact: Murray was playing in his first game back from the concussion protocol. He lost Justin Jefferson early for the day. He targeted Jordan Addison heavily, including on a 41-yard touchdown. He'll face the Dolphins next week.

news.body: Kyler Murray has cleared concussion protocol and will start against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers on Sunday.
news.head: Kyler Murray clears concussion protocol, will start Week 3
news.impact: Murray missed the Vikings Week 2 slog of a win over the Bears, but he will be back in the lineup for Week 3 against a hapless Tampa defense. Murray is still a bit of an unknown at this point given he barely played in Week 1, but this is a perfect matchup to return to.

news.body: The Baltimore Ravens have ruled out quarterback Lamar Jackson for their Week 6 matchup with the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.head: Lamar Jackson (ankle) ruled out for Week 7
news.impact: Jackson last played on Oct. 4 against the Tennessee Titans, throwing for two scores and 222 yards in one half. The Ravens are 1-1 in that stretch, with Tyler Huntley starting under center. A key divisional matchup awaits in a competitive AFC North, and Jackson could return in Week 8 against the Buffalo Bills.

news.body: Lamar Jackson (ankle) is officially questionable for Sunday's game against the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.head: Lamar Jackson (ankle) officially questionable for Sunday
news.impact: Jackson has missed the past couple of games due to an ankle injury, but he is officially questionable for Week 7 and will have a chance to make his return to the lineup on Sunday. All of Baltimore's relevant fantasy options will see a nice boost if he's back in the lineup this week, even if he's slightly limited by the lingering effects of his injury.

news.body: Lamar Jackson (ankle) is practicing for the Baltimore Ravens Friday according to Jamison Hensley.
news.head: Lamar Jackson (ankle) practicing Friday
news.impact: Jackson has been able to log limited practice session over the past couple of days as the quarterback continues to work back from a two-game absence for head coach Jesse Minter. Fantasy managers will need to monitor the team’s injury report ahead of a potential return against the Cincinnati Bengals in Week 7.

news.body: Lamar Jackson was present at practice again on Thursday.
news.head: Lamar Jackson (ankle) practices Thursday
news.impact: Jackson was listed as a limited participant in practice on Wednesday. It appears with another practice, he'll have a chance to return for Sunday's game against the Bengals.

news.body: Matthew Stafford completed 25-of-33 passing attempts for 222 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 18-16 loss to the Arizona Cardinals.
news.head: Matthew Stafford throws two touchdowns in loss Sunday
news.impact: Stafford looked pretty good on Sunday. He threw for over 200 yards and two touchdowns over the course of the afternoon, but that wasn't enough for the Rams, as they still put up just 16 points and suffered a loss at the hands of the Cardinals. Stafford should continue to be a relevant fantasy option for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Matthew Stafford completed 40 of his 54 pass attempts for 383 yards and three touchdowns in a 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills in Week 5.
news.head: Matthew Stafford throws three TDs in Week 5 loss
news.impact: Stafford turned in a huge game in the Monday night loss to Buffalo, but he couldn't put any points on the board in overtime. The veteran quarterback threw two touchdown passes to Davante Adams, while his third went to Puka Nacua. Stafford has now thrown for 1,572 yards, nine touchdowns, and six interceptions through five games. He will be a solid QB1 in fantasy in Week 6 vs. the Cardinals.

news.body: Matthew Stafford completed 32-of-51 passing attempts for 317 yards and two interceptions in Sunday's 24-20 win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.head: Matthew Stafford doesn't score in win Sunday
news.impact: Stafford was able to lead the Rams to a win on Sunday, but he wasn't able to find a lot of personal success in the process. He failed to score even a single touchdown in this matchup, and he also threw two interceptions, which left him with a poor fantasy total. He should bounce back and return to form sometime in the near future, however,

news.body: Matthew Stafford completed 30-of-55 passing attempts for 390 yards, two touchdowns, and two interceptions while adding 13 yards on the ground in Sunday night's 30-26 loss to the Denver Broncos.
news.head: Matthew Stafford totals 403 yards in loss Sunday
news.impact: Stafford had an up-and-down game on Sunday night. He finished with over 400 total yards and two touchdowns, but he also threw two interceptions, one of which was returned for a touchdown. He made some mistakes that opened the door for Denver to win this game, but fantasy managers should be happy with his production and should continue to start him in favorable matchups moving forward.

news.body: Trevor Lawrence completed 24-of-41 passes for 306 yards, four touchdowns, and one interception in a 34-31 loss to Houston. He added 11 rushing yards on three carries.
news.head: Trevor Lawrence tosses four touchdowns in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Lawrence and the Jaguars' offense turned heavily to the passing game in the second half after falling behind Houston early. Lawrence was able to top 300 yards passing for the second straight game and set a new season high in passing attempts. Lawrence and the Jaguars will head to a bye in Week 7.

news.body: Trevor Lawrence completed 24 of 39 passes for 331 yards with two touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 19-17 win over the Eagles.
news.head: Trevor Lawrence clears 300 yards for the first time this season
news.impact: Lawrence not only passed for a new season-high in yards Sunday, but he also gained 25 yards on the ground for the second time through the first five weeks. Lawrence is averaging just under 235 passing yards per game on the campaign, with a 67.1% completion rate and a 10-3 TD/INT ratio. He'll face the division-rival Texans in Week 6, and remains a definite QB1.

news.body: Trevor Lawrence completed 18-of-23 passing attempts for 227 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 22-17 win over the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.head: Trevor Lawrence scores once in win Sunday
news.impact: Lawrence was able to lead the Jaguars to a win on Sunday, but he wasn't able to rack up many fantasy points in the process, finishing with just one touchdown over the course of the afternoon. Almost all of Jacksonville's fantasy options disappointed in this matchup, but they should be able to bounce back in a competitive matchup against the Eagles next week.

news.body: Trevor Lawrence completed 19-of-29 passing attempts for 182 yards, three touchdowns, and one interception while adding 25 yards on the ground in Sunday's 35-6 blowout win over the New England Patriots.
news.head: Trevor Lawrence tosses three touchdowns in blowout win Sunday
news.impact: Lawrence played a stellar game on Sunday, finishing with over 200 total yards and three touchdowns in a big win over the Patriots. He has been playing well so far this season and will continue to be a viable starting option for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Tyler Shough completed 16-of-30 passes for 144 yards and three touchdowns in the Saints 34-27 win over the Giants.
news.head: Tyler Shough throws three touchdowns Sunday
news.impact: Shough continues to play through broken bones in his non-throwing hand. After a slow start in the first quarter, he had a solid afternoon the rest of the game. He also added another touchdown on the ground. He'll face the Steelers next week.

news.body: Tyler Shough (hand) logged another full practice session on Thursday.
news.head: Tyler Shough (hand) logs another full practice Thursday
news.impact: The young quarterback's hand injury isn't serious and hasn't affected his participation at practice all week thus far. He should play and will be looking to bounce back on Sunday after a disappointing performance in Week 5.

news.body: Tyler Shough (hand) practiced in a full capacity on Wednesday.
news.head: Tyler Shough (hand) practices in full Wednesday
news.impact: The young quarterback was able to practice in a full capacity on Wednesday, despite still dealing with a hand issue of some kind. He should be good to go for Week 6, however, and this issue shouldn't play a big factor for fantasy managers when they weigh whether or not to start him against the Giants this week.

news.body: Saints QB Tyler Shough is reportedly playing through a hand injury.
news.head: Tyler Shough playing through hand injury
news.impact: Saints head coach Kellen Moore was asked directly whether Shough's hand is broken. "It got banged two weeks ago and he's just wearing some protective layers there," he said. It doesn't appear Shough is in danger of missing any time, but he'll need to be monitored on the injury report this week.

news.body: Aaron Jones Sr. carried the ball 25 times for 113 yards and one touchdown while also hauling in all three of his targets for four yards in the Vikings' 23-13 Week 5 win over the New Orleans Saints.
news.head: Aaron Jones Sr. leads ground attack in Week 5 win over Saints
news.impact: Jones Sr. has been impactful out of the Minnesota backfield of late, surpassing 90 offensive yards in each of the last four games. The veteran running back offers head coach Kevin O'Connell one of the few reliable offensive options as the Vikings enter their Week 6 bye.

news.body: Aaron Jones Sr. (knee) is questionable to return for the Minnesota Vikings against the New Orleans Saints Sunday.
news.head: Aaron Jones Sr. (knee) questionable to return Sunday
news.impact: Jones Sr. carried the ball seven times for 28 yards with a fumble lost while also catching his only target for one yard prior to suffering the injury. Demond Claiborne will take over in the backfield for head coach Kevin O’Connell against the Saints.

news.body: Aaron Jones Sr. was limited in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Aaron Jones Sr. (rest) limited in practice Wednesday
news.impact: Jones gets a rest day to begin the week. He remains a steady RB2 while Jordan Mason is sidelined.

news.body: Aaron Jones Sr. rushed the ball 20 times for 94 yards and caught 4-of-8 targets for 34 yards in Sunday's 15-10 win over the Miami Dolphins.
news.head: Aaron Jones Sr. totals 128 yards Sunday
news.impact: The veteran played well on Sunday. He logged 128 total yards against the Dolphins, and he was able to do that while maintaining good efficiency. He will continue to be a worthwhile fantasy option for however long Jordan Mason (thumb) remains out of the lineup for the Vikings.

news.body: Alvin Kamara (back) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
news.head: Alvin Kamara (back) limited participant Thursday
news.impact: To no surprise, Kamara was left limited for another practice on Thursday due to the back injury that he's managing. He should play in Week 7, but it remains unlikely that he will have a strong performance from a fantasy perspective.

news.body: Alvin Kamara (back) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Alvin Kamara (back) limited at practice Wednesday
news.impact: Kamara was limited by a back injury on Wednesday, but that has been common for him over the course of the season and shouldn't prevent him from playing in Week 7. Fantasy managers shouldn't have high expectations for him moving forward, however.

news.body: Alvin Kamara ran for 34 yards on seven carries in the Saints 34-27 win over the Giants. He also caught 2-of-4 targets for 35 yards receiving and a touchdown.
news.head: Alvin Kamara hauls in receiving touchdown Sunday
news.impact: The big play on the day for Kamara was a 31-yard catch and run for a touchdown where the Giants missed multiple tackles. He'll be on the flex radar next week against the Steelers.

news.body: Saints RB Alvin Kamara (back) is officially active for a Week 6 matchup with the Giants.
news.head: Alvin Kamara (back) officially active for Week 6
news.impact: Kamara was considered questionable to play after being limited in practice throughout the week. Kamara is likely a flex play at best in deeper leagues right now.

news.body: Ashton Jeanty rushed the ball ten times for 22 yards and a touchdown and caught 4-of-6 targets for 36 yards in Sunday's 33-30 loss to the Buffalo Bills.
news.head: Ashton Jeanty inefficient in loss Sunday
news.impact: Jeanty ended up having a decent fantasy outing on Sunday between his involvement in the receiving game and his touchdown on the ground. But he was very inefficient on the ground, rushing at a clip of just 2.2 yards per carry, and finished with less rushing yards than Mike Washington Jr., who was more involved than expected again Buffalo. Fantasy managers should continue to monitor Jeanty moving forward, especially to see if he's still dealing with any nagging injuries at this point.

news.body: Ashton Jeanty (foot) logged a full practice session on Wednesday.
news.head: Ashton Jeanty (foot) logs full practice Wednesday
news.impact: There has been some recent speculation that Jeanty is not at full health, but while he is listed on Las Vegas' injury report, he was able to practice in full on Wednesday and should be good to go for Week 6. Fantasy managers should continue to start him, but after a slow start to the season, they should have tempered expectations for his efficiency for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Raiders coach Klint Kubiak said Ashton Jeanty is starting to “feel a lot better” physically.
news.head: Ashton Jeanty 'feeling a lot better physically' per Klint Kubiak
news.impact: There had been rumors of the Raiders potentially having Jeanty sit a week to get fully healthy. When asked if the team considered sitting Jeanty to get him healthy, Kubiak said, “he’s playing.”

news.body: Ashton Jeanty rushed for 27 yards on 10 carries in the Raiders loss to the Patriots. He caught 3-of-6 targets for 50 yards in the loss.
news.head: Ashton Jeanty struggles in Week 5 loss
news.impact: Jeanty entered the game questionable with an ankle/foot injury, which could have led to his struggles against the Patriots. Jeanty will look to bounce back in Week 6 against the Bills.

news.body: Bam Knight rushed the ball 15 times for 80 yards and caught two passes for 18 yards in Sunday's 18-16 win over the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Bam Knight leads team in rushing Sunday
news.impact: Knight stepped up on Sunday with rookie Jeremiyah Love (ankle) out of the lineup for Arizona. He was able to churn out 98 total yards over the course of the afternoon while maintaining an efficient clip of 5.3 yards per carry on the ground. He won't continue to be relevant when Love is able to make his return to the lineup in the near future, however.

news.body: The Cardinals re-signed RB Zonovan Knight to a one-year contract.
news.head: Zonovan Knight re-signs with Cardinals
news.impact: Knight will remain in a depth role in the Cardinals backfield. He will be behind James Conner, Tyler Allgeier, and Trey Benson.

news.body: The Cardinals place RB Zonavan Knight on injured reserve.
news.head: Zonovan Knight (ankle) headed to IR
news.impact: Knight recorded one carry for -2 yards before suffering the ankle injury. Expect an RB committee between Michael Carter and Emari Demercado going forward.

news.body: Zonovan Knight suffered a "bad ankle sprain" in Sunday's loss against the Texans and is not expected to play in Week 16.
news.head: Zonovan Knight suffers 'bad ankle sprain,' unlikely to play in Week 16
news.impact: Knight was twisted up badly on Sunday and did not return. He will undergo an MRI on Monday to confirm the diagnosis. Michael Carter should lead the Cardinals backfield in his place.

news.body: Bhayshul Tuten rushed for 39 yards on 12 carries in the 34-31 loss to the Texans. He caught 5-of-7 targets for 48 yards and two touchdowns.
news.head: Bhayshul Tuten hits pay dirt twice in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Tuten did have a rushing touchdown called back on a holding call, limiting his rushing output. His two touchdowns receptions marked his first receiving touchdowns of the season, and is a good sign for him being more involved in the passing game in the future. Tuten and the Jaguars will head to the bye in Week 7.

news.body: Bhayshul Tuten rushed for 72 yards on 22 carries, adding two receptions for 24 yards in Sunday's 19-17 win over the Eagles.
news.head: Bhayshul Tuten approaches 100 yards of total offense Sunday
news.impact: Tuten continues to prove he can shoulder the load out of the Jaguars' backfield. The second-year pro only averaged 3.3 yards on his career-high 22 carries Sunday, but he seemed to run stronger as the game progressed. For the season, Tuten is averaging 70 yards on more than 16 carries per game with a couple of touchdowns. He's a solid RB2 with upside in most fantasy formats.

news.body: Bhayshul Tuten rushed the ball 17 times for 73 yards and caught two passes for 18 yards in Sunday's 22-17 win over the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.head: Bhayshul Tuten racks up 91 yards in win Sunday
news.impact: Tuten had a good game on Sunday, finishing as the team's top rusher and dominating the touches in the backfield en route to a win over the Bengals. Chris Rodriguez Jr. was the one to get into the end zone for the Jaguars, however, which was annoying for fantasy managers to see. The young running back should continue to be a worthwhile fantasy asset moving forward.

news.body: Bhayshul Tuten rushed the ball 15 times for 73 yards and caught two passes for 17 yards in Sunday's 35-6 win over the New England Patriots.
news.head: Bhayshul Tuten leads team in rushing Sunday
news.impact: Tuten had a good game on Sunday. He led the team in rushing yards at an efficient clip of 4.9 yards per carry, and he was also able to get into the end zone at one point, which left him with a great fantasy total. He should again be started in a matchup against the Bengals next week.

news.body: Bijan Robinson carried the ball nine times for 61 yards while also catching both of his targets for a loss of eight yards in the Falcons' 31-23 Week 6 loss to the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Bijan Robinson bottled up in Week 6 loss to Bears
news.impact: Robinson struggled to make an impact out of the backfield, recording less than 70 offensive yards for the first time in six contests. The running back remains locked in as a strong RB1 option in all formats ahead of a Week 7 matchup against the San Francisco 49ers.

news.body: Bijan Robinson gained 86 yards on 17 carries and caught 4-of-7 targets for 32 yards in Sunday's 30-23 OT loss to the Ravens.
news.head: Bijan Robinson totals 118 yards on 21 touches in Week 5
news.impact: Robinson continues to be one of the elite offensive weapons in the league, as the dual-threat back is averaging 116 rushing yards and more than 30 receiving yards per game this season. Robinson scored twice on the ground in both Week 3 and Week 4, but he couldn't keep the TD streak going Sunday night against the Ravens. He will look to start a new one in Week 6 against the Bears.

news.body: Bijan Robinson rushed the ball 19 times for 145 yards and two touchdowns in Monday night's 45-24 win over the New Orleans Saints.
news.head: Bijan Robinson dominant in blowout win Monday
news.impact: Robinson was absolutely dominant on Monday night. He led the Falcons in rushing with 145 yards on the night at a hyper-efficient clip of 7.6 yards per carry, and he was also able to get into the end zone on two separate occasions. He let a little to be desired in the passing game, but that was simply because the Falcons were up so much for so long. He has been stellar over the first four weeks of the season and should continue to be one of the best assets in all of fantasy moving forward.

news.body: Bijan Robinson ran 29 times for 194 yards and two touchdowns and caught both of his targets for 19 yards in the Falcons' 35-14 win over the Packers on Thursday.
news.head: Bijan Robinson explodes in Week 3 win over Packers
news.impact: Robinson had his way with the Packers' defense, rushing for 6.7 yards per carry. He ripped off a huge 55-yard gain early on in the game, which opened the floodgates for many more big runs throughout the game. The Packers simply could not stop him, and once the ground game got going, QB Michael Penix and WR Drake London were able to carve up the Packers' secondary. With Penix back, the offense has new life, and Bijan stands to benefit greatly from it, even if Brian Robinson Jr. spells him.

news.body: Blake Corum rushed the ball nine times for 42 yards and caught two passes for 18 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 18-16 loss to the Arizona Cardinals.
news.head: Blake Corum scores once in loss Sunday
news.impact: Corum got involved on Sunday, seeing 11 total touches in the team's loss to the Cardinals. He was able to get into the end zone on one of his catches, but he still didn't end up with more than just a solid fantasy total. He will likely continue to serve as an involved RB2 behind Kyren Williams moving forward.

news.body: Blake Corum carried the ball five times for 19 yards and a touchdown while catching three of his four targets for 53 yards in a 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills in Week 5.
news.head: Blake Corum finds the end zone in Week 5
news.impact: While still playing behind starter Kyren Williams, Corum turned in his most productive game of the year in the Monday night loss. He found the end zone for his first touchdown of the season on a one-yard run in the third quarter. Corum will remain a top fantasy handcuff behind Williams, but he is still just a low-end flex option in Week 6 vs. the Cardinals.

news.body: Blake Corum rushed the ball five times for 14 yards and caught one pass for seven yards in Sunday's 24-20 win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.head: Blake Corum a non-factor in win Sunday
news.impact: Corum didn't play much of a role for the Rams in Week 4. He saw just six touches over the course of the game and was only able to turn them into 21 yards, as opposed to Kyren Williams' 26 touches for 147 yards. Fantasy managers shouldn't have much hope for Corum to have standalone value anytime soon.

news.body: Blake Corum rushed the ball six times for 15 yards and caught 2-of-4 targets for zero yards in Sunday's 30-26 loss to the Denver Broncos.
news.head: Blake Corum quiet in loss Sunday
news.impact: Corum wasn't able to contribute much on Sunday. He totaled just 15 yards on his ten opportunities over the course of the night, which left him with a very poor fantasy total. He will continue to see a good amount of work in Los Angeles' offense moving forward but will likely continue to fall behind Kyren Williams in competitive matchups.

news.body: Braelon Allen rushed for 78 yards on 17 carries in the Jets' 26-19 loss to the Patriots. He caught both of his targets for 26 yards.
news.head: Braelon Allen sees 19 touches in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Allen continued to see the bulk of the carries for the Jets with Breece Hall (quad) out injured. Fantasy managers should expect Allen to continue to operate as the Jets' RB1 if Hall is not cleared to return against Miami next week.

news.body: Braelon Allen carried the ball 24 times for 116 yards and a touchdown while catching one of his four targets for no gain in a 17-12 win over the Browns in Week 5.
news.head: Braelon Allen finds the end zone in Week 5
news.impact: Allen looked excellent on a rainy afternoon at MetLife Stadium. He ripped off an impressive 22-yard touchdown run to put the Jets up for good in the fourth quarter. Allen will be on the RB2 radar in Week 6 against the Patriots.

news.body: Braelon Allen carried the ball 14 times for 59 yards while catching both of his targets for eight yards in a 23-12 loss to the Bears in Week 4.
news.head: Braelon Allen runs for 59 yards in Week 4 loss
news.impact: Allen got all of the backfield touches but wasn't able to do much with them, averaging just 4.2 yards per carry in the loss. With Breece Hall (quad) looking at least another week or two away from returning, Allen should operate as the Jets' lead back again in Week 5 against the Browns.

news.body: Braelon Allen rushed for 14 yards on four carries in the 31-24 loss to the Lions. He caught all three of his targets for three yards.
news.head: Braelon Allen tallies seven touches in Week 3
news.impact: Allen continued to see limited work Sunday, but he could be in line for more touches in Week 4 if Breece Hall (thigh) misses time. Hall was injured late in the game and will likely undergo testing Monday to determine the severity of the injury.

news.body: Breece Hall (quad) has been listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Dolphins.
news.head: Breece Hall (quad) questionable for Sunday
news.impact: Hall returned to practice in a limited capacity on Thursday, and it appears he has at least a chance to finally return to the Jets' backfield this week. The dual-threat back has not played since Week 3, ceding a workhorse role to backup Braelon Allen, who has been quite productive with the opportunity. If Hall does return, he could be on a limited snap count, sharing the load with Allen.

news.body: Breece Hall (quad) returned to practice as a limited participant on Thursday.
news.head: Breece Hall (quad) returns to practice Thursday
news.impact: Hall was a non-participant on Wednesday to start the week, but he made his return to practice on Thursday and will have a real chance to play in Week 7. Fantasy managers should keep close tabs on updates about his health heading into the weekend to see if he will play and have any limitations against the Dolphins on Sunday.

news.body: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said Breece Hall will not return to practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Breece Hall (quad) will not practice Wednesday
news.impact: Glenn added that Hall will be evaluated as the week goes on. He is currently unlikely to return this week, leaving Braelon Allen in line for another start.

news.body: Breece Hall (quad) will not play in Sunday's game against the Patriots.
news.head: Breece Hall (quad) officially ruled out for Week 6
news.impact: Hall will miss a third straight game due to a quad injury. Braelon Allen will shoulder the load out of the Jets' backfield once again in Week 6.

news.body: Bucky Irving (illness) was back at practice as a limited participant on Thursday.
news.head: Bucky Irving (illness) back at practice Thursday
news.impact: Irving is currently recovering from an illness of some kind and missed Wednesday's practice as a result, but he was back at practice on Thursday and participated in a limited capacity. That's a good sign that he will be fully good to go for Sunday's game against the Panthers.

news.body: Bucky Irving returned to practice on Thursday.
news.head: Bucky Irving (illness) practices Thursday
news.impact: Irving missed practice on Wednesday. He should be good to go for Sunday's game against the Panthers.

news.body: Bucky Irving (illness) missed Tampa Bay's practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Bucky Irving (illness) misses practice Wednesday
news.impact: Irving was absent from the team's first practice of the week on Wednesday, as he is currently recovering from an illness of some kind. It doesn't look like it will pose much of a threat for his availability for Week 7, so for now, fantasy managers should plan on him playing in a full capacity on Sunday.

news.body: Bucky Irving ran for 46 yards on 19 carries in the Buccaneers 26-19 loss against the Steelers. He also caught 2-of-3 targets for three yards receiving.
news.head: Bucky Irving sees 19 carries Sunday
news.impact: Irving struggled in a much tougher matchup compared to last week. His involvement in the passing game is also limited with Jalon Daniels behind center. He'll remain a touchdown dependent RB2 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Cam Skattebo did not see a carry in the Giants 34-27 loss against the Saints on Sunday.
news.head: Cam Skattebo does not see a carry Sunday
news.impact: There were reports of a potential benching for Skattebo with his recent fumble issues. He did not see a carry and was on the field for just a handful of snaps. His role will be uncertain heading into next week against the Texans.

news.body: Cam Skattebo rushed 13 times for 59 yards while also catching two of his three targets for 12 yards in the Giants' 27-27 tie with the Washington Commanders in Week 5.
news.head: Cam Skattebo leads backfield in Week 5 tie
news.impact: Skattebo has been mostly steady out of the New York backfield to this point, rushing for over 55 yards in four of five contests. The running back will look for an impactful performance in a Week 6 contest against the New Orleans Saints.

news.body: Cam Skattebo told reporters he will play on Sunday against the Commanders.
news.head: Cam Skattebo (shoulder) will play Sunday
news.impact: Skattebo said he had a "little muscle tightness" in his shoulder. It's why he wore a red no-contact jersey on Wednesday. He'll remain a steady RB2 play.

news.body: Cam Skattebo (shoulder) was limited at New York's practice on Thursday.
news.head: Cam Skattebo (shoulder) limited at practice Thursday
news.impact: Skattebo was a limited participant at practice on Thursday. He's still dealing with a shoulder issue of some kind and is likely considered day-to-day for the time being. It looks likely that he will play in Week 5, and he will have a good opportunity to put up some real fantasy points this week in a favorable matchup against the Commanders.

news.body: Chase Brown rushed the ball 13 times for 39 yards and caught 3-of-4 targets for 21 yards in Sunday's 31-24 win over the Miami Dolphins.
news.head: Chase Brown underwhelming in win Sunday
news.impact: The young running back wasn't able to get much going on Sunday. He totaled 50 yards over his 17 opportunities, and he wasn't able to get into the end zone at all, which left him with an underwhelming fantasy total. He should bounce back and look better after Cincinnati's bye week this week, but his production may continue to be inconsistent moving forward.

news.body: Chase Brown rushed the ball nine times for ten yards and hauled in 11 catches for 71 yards in Sunday's 22-17 loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars.
news.head: Chase Brown hauls in 11 passes Sunday
news.impact: Brown was very ineffective as a rusher on Sunday, finishing with just ten yards in a loss to the Jaguars. He was able to contribute heavily through the passing game, however, logging 71 yards on a whopping 11 catches. The Bengals may need to lean on him in the passing game again next week with Ja'Marr Chase (concussion) and Tee Higgins (adductor) both at risk to be sidelined against the Dolphins.

news.body: Chase Brown rushed for 61 yards on 13 carries in a 30-27 loss to the Steelers. He caught both of his targets for eight yards.
news.head: Chase Brown quiet in Week 3 loss
news.impact: Brown saw a season low in rushing attempts and targets. Despite the lower volume against Pittsburgh, fantasy managers should expect Brown to remain the workhorse running back for the Bengals in Week 4 against the Jaguars.

news.body: Chase Brown ran for 80 yards on 20 carries in the Bengals 20-6 win over the Texans on Sunday. He also caught 3-of-5 targets for two yards receiving.
news.head: Chase Brown sees 20 carries Sunday
news.impact: Brown did not find the end zone. He ran well, but it was still a fairly quiet day for him overall for fantasy managers. He'll remain an RB1 against the Steelers next week.

news.body: Christian McCaffrey carried the ball 16 times for 64 yards and two touchdowns while catching nine of his 10 targets for 53 yards in a 23-17 win over the Commanders in Week 6's Monday night game. He also lost a fumble in the contest.
news.head: Christian McCaffrey scores two TDs in Week 6
news.impact: McCaffrey turned in a huge performance in the close win. He scored his touchdowns on a pair of one-yard runs in the first half, while he led the 49ers in targets and receptions. With seven total touchdowns through his first six games this year, the veteran tailback will be a top-three fantasy option heading into Week 7's road matchup vs. the Falcons.

news.body: Christian McCaffrey (rest) was absent from practice on Thursday.
news.head: Christian McCaffrey (rest) absent from practice Thursday
news.impact: Thursday was San Francisco's first practice of the week, so to no surprise, they gave McCaffrey the day off as a veteran rest day. He should be back on Friday and is expected to be a full go for Monday night's game against the Washington Commanders.

news.body: Christian McCaffrey ran for 68 yards and a touchdown on 11 carries in the 49ers 32-29 win over the Seahawks on Sunday. He also caught 3-of-3 targets for 15 yards receiving.
news.head: Christian McCaffrey finds the end zone Sunday
news.impact: McCaffrey continues to find the end zone to make up for his lack of yardage on the season. He scored right after a fumble by Emanuel Wilson this week. He remains an RB1 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Christian McCaffrey rushed 15 times for 52 yards and a touchdown while catching three of his five targets for 18 yards in Sunday's 24-14 win over the Denver Broncos.
news.head: Christian McCaffrey scores touchdown in win Sunday
news.impact: McCaffrey didn't have his biggest day from a yardage standpoint, but he found the end zone on a one-yard run in the fourth quarter. He finished with 18 touches and remains the clear lead back in San Francisco. McCaffrey remains a must-start option heading into Week 5 against Seattle.

news.body: Chuba Hubbard (rest) returned to practice in a full capacity on Thursday.
news.head: Chuba Hubbard (rest) returns to full practice Thursday
news.impact: Hubbard was given the day off on Wednesday as a veteran rest day, but he returned to practice on Thursday and was a full participant. He should be good to go for Week 7 and remains a must-start fantasy option for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Chuba Hubbard (rest) was absent from Carolina's practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Chuba Hubbard (rest) absent from practice Wednesday
news.impact: Hubbard was given the day off on Wednesday as a typical veteran rest day. He should be back on Thursday and should be good to go for Week 7, assuming nothing happens at practice this week.

news.body: Carolina Panthers running back Chuba Hubbard recorded 120 yards on 28 carries and caught one pass for one yard, punching in a rushing touchdown in a Week 6 win over Philadelphia.
news.head: Chuba Hubbard totals 120 yards, score vs. Eagles
news.impact: Hubbard's Week 6 outing was a season high in carries; the count has increased every single week. His rushing touchdown was his fourth this season and sixth overall. Hubbard has more than delivered on his draft capital and has been a main feature for Carolina, dominating the backfield touches.

news.body: Chuba Hubbard rushed for 122 yards and two touchdowns on 20 carries in Sunday's 32-26 win over the Lions.
news.head: Chuba Hubbard delivers big performance Sunday night
news.impact: The Lions' defense could not stop the pass or the run Sunday night. Hubbard turned in his highest rushing total since December 2024 in this contest. The 27-year-old back has now gained more than 200 yards on 39 carries over the last two weeks, proving himself capable of being a workhorse back yet again. Hubbard will return to the field for a matchup with the Eagles in Week 6.

news.body: Philadelphia Eagles running back Dameon Pierce carried the ball 12 times for 35 yards and a score and caught four passes for 15 yards in a loss to the Carolina Panthers.
news.head: Dameon Pierce scores in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Pierce made his first start since 2023 with Houston. Saquon Barkley is recovering from a hamstring injury, and Tank Bigsby and Will Shipley are both on injured reserve, which could make Pierce the starter for another week or two. He is likely to be a touchdown-dependent FLEX option in an offense missing several pieces, though he dominated the backfield touches in Week 6.

news.body: Dameon Pierce gained 14 yards on 11 carries and netted negative yardage on two receptions in Sunday's 19-17 loss to the Jaguars.
news.head: Dameon Pierce does little with 13 touches in Sunday's loss
news.impact: After Will Shipley (foot) exited Sunday's game early, Pierce took on more of the load than expected out of the Eagles' backfield. Pierce was making both his Eagles and regular-season debuts after being elevated this week. Pierce was unable to get much going against a stingy Jacksonville run defense. The beaten-up Philly backfield could get Saquon Barkley back for Week 6.

news.body: The Eagles activated RB Dameon Pierce to the team’s active roster.
news.head: Dameon Pierce activated to Eagles' active roster
news.impact: Pierce will figure to backup Will Shipley in the Eagles backfield with Saquon Barkley and Tank Bigsby both sidelined.

news.body: The Eagles signed RB Dameon Pierce to the practice squad.
news.head: Dameon Pierce signs with Eagles practice squad
news.impact: Pierce was released by the Eagles on Sunday. He'll remain with them on their practice squad.

news.body: D'Andre Swift rushed for 78 yards and a touchdown on 22 carries, adding four receptions for 12 yards in Thursday's 30-24 win over the Patriots.
news.head: D'Andre Swift finds the end zone in Week 7 win
news.impact: With Kyle Monangai (thumb, toe) still out and Roschon Johnson not very involved, Swift shouldered a workhorse load against the Patriots on Thursday night. The dual-threat back averaged less than 3.5 yards per touch, but he did find the end zone for the seventh time this season, which has him currently tied for second in the NFL in rushing touchdowns. Swift will go up against the Seahawks' defense in Week 8. He remains a low-end RB1 for standard fantasy leagues.

news.body: D'Andre Swift rushed 16 times for 44 yards and two touchdowns while also hauling in four of his five targets for 26 yards in the Bears' 31-23 Week 6 win over the Atlanta Falcons.
news.head: D'Andre Swift reaches end zone twice in Week 6 win over Falcons
news.impact: Swift continues an impactful stretch out of the Chicago backfield, finishing with over 70 offensive yards in each of his six contests. The running back will look for another impactful performance against the New England Patriots in Week 7.

news.body: D'Andre Swift carried the ball nine times for 43 yards and one touchdown while also catching four of his five targets for 30 yards in the Bears' 31-7 Week 5 loss to the Green Bay Packers.
news.head: D'Andre Swift reaches end zone in Week 5 loss to Packers
news.impact: Swift continues a strong start to the season out of the Chicago backfield, finishing with over 70 offensive yards in each of the first five games. The running back remains a reliable option out of the backfield in all formats, with a Week 6 matchup against the Atlanta Falcons up next.

news.body: D'Andre Swift (hip/knee) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Green Bay Packers.
news.head: D'Andre Swift (hip/knee) good to go for Sunday
news.impact: Swift will be available to play on Sunday, despite missing practice earlier in the week due to a couple of different injuries. He should play without limitations and will see even more work than usual with Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) set to be sidelined against the Packers.

news.body: Baltimore Ravens running back Derrick Henry ran for 58 yards on 17 carries and caught one pass for two yards in the team's 13-10 loss in Cleveland.
news.head: Derrick Henry gains 60 scoreless yards in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Henry was held scoreless for the first time this season, ending a five-game streak of rushing/receiving touchdowns that had opened the year. He also lost a fumble in the tight contest. Henry's long-term outlook remains strong, but with Lamar Jackson sidelined, there is a lower floor for his output.

news.body: Derrick Henry rushed for 102 yards on 24 carries, adding an 18-yard touchdown reception in Sunday's 30-23 OT win over the Falcons.
news.head: Derrick Henry eclipses 100 yards, catches TD in Week 5
news.impact: Henry picked up 32 of his rushing yards in the Ravens' one overtime possession, but he nevertheless recorded his highest yardage total since Week 1. This was the first time in five games in which Henry did not find the end zone on the ground, but he did come up with his first TD reception of the season. Even in his 11th NFL season, Henry remains among the best running backs in the league.

news.body: Derrick Henry rushed for 73 yards and a touchdown on 23 carries in the Ravens win over the Titans. He caught both of his targets for six yards.
news.head: Derrick Henry finds the end zone in Week 4 win
news.impact: Henry opened the scoring with a five-yard plunge into the end zone in the first quarter. The veteran running back has found the end zone at least once in each of the team's first four games. Fantasy managers should expect Henry to remain a key factor for the Ravens heading into a Week 5 matchup in Atlanta.

news.body: Derrick Henry carried the ball 26 times for 89 yards and two touchdowns while catching his lone target for no gain in a 34-31 win over the Cowboys in Week 3.
news.head: Derrick Henry scores two more TDs in Week 3
news.impact: Henry continued to dominate in the high-scoring win over the Cowboys in Rio de Janeiro. The veteran running back punched in scores from three and four yards out in the win, giving him six touchdowns through the first three games of the season. Overall, he's rushed for 301 yards while adding five catches for 38 yards this year. Henry will be a high-end RB1 in Week 4 against the Titans.

news.body: Emanuel Wilson ran 14 times for 52 yards and failed to catch his only target in the Seahawks' 17-14 loss to the Broncos on Thursday.
news.head: Emanuel Wilson goes for 52 yards in loss
news.impact: Wilson had two weeks as the primary running back option for the Seahawks and produced in those chances. But with the return of George Holani, that window of production came to a close. Wilson still lead the backfield in touches, but he didn't get the passing or rushing work to himself like he needed. And with the return of Zach Charbonnet looming and Jadarian Price's return soon to follow after that, Wilson's usage period is coming to a close.

news.body: Emanuel Wilson ran for 61 yards and a touchdown on 20 carries in the Seahawks 32-29 loss against the 49ers. He also caught 2-of-2 targets for 11 yards receiving.
news.head: Emanuel Wilson finds the end zone Sunday
news.impact: Wilson put the Seahawks on the board following a punt on a fumble return by Jacob Cowing. He also lost a fumble on the day. He'll likely remain an RB2 for one more week on Thursday against the Broncos before the likely return of Zach Charbonnet.

news.body: Emanuel Wilson ran for 81 yards and a touchdown on 21 carries in the Seahawks 30-23 win over the Chargers. He also caught 3-of-4 targets for 39 yards receiving and another score.
news.head: Emanuel Wilson scores twice Sunday
news.impact: After a fumble on a muffled punt by the Chargers early, Wilson took a screen pass from Sam Darnold to the house for the first score of the day. He was the clear workhorse in the first game since Jadarian Price was placed on IR.

news.body: Emanuel Wilson rushed nine times for 14 yards in the Seahawks’ 33-31 loss to the Washington Commanders in Week 3.
news.head: Emanuel Wilson quiet in Week 3 loss
news.impact: Wilson has struggled to make an impact out of the backfield to begin the season, recording less than 10 carries in two of three contests. The running back remains difficult to trust in a Seattle backfield with more questions than answers currently, with a Week 4 contest against the Los Angeles Chargers up next.

news.body: Jahmyr Gibbs rushed the ball 25 times for 151 yards and two touchdowns and caught five passes for 56 yards in Sunday's 45-21 win over the Arizona Cardinals.
news.head: Jahmyr Gibbs dominant in win Sunday
news.impact: Gibbs had yet another dominant game on Sunday. He logged over 200 total yards and two touchdowns in an easy win over the Cardinals as he continues the historic pace that he has been producing at through the first five weeks of the season. There's no reason to think he will slow down anytime soon, so fantasy managers should continue to value him as a top-tier fantasy asset for as long as he remains healthy and on the field.

news.body: Jahmyr Gibbs rushed for 46 yards and a touchdown on 15 carries, adding 31 yards on four catches in Sunday's 32-26 loss to the Panthers.
news.head: Jahmyr Gibbs finds the end zone in Week 4
news.impact: Gibbs was limited to a season-low 77 yards of offense Sunday, but he still found the end zone for the seventh time in four weeks. The Panthers' defense did a solid job of holding Gibbs to 3.1 yards per carry and another season-low of four receptions. Still, the dynamic back remains an elite, dual-threat option heading to Arizona in Week 5.

news.body: Jahmyr Gibbs rushed for 99 yards and two touchdowns on 20 carries in a 31-24 win over the Jets. He caught 7-of-8 targets for 65 yards and a touchdown.
news.head: Jahmyr Gibbs tallies three touchdowns in Week 3 win
news.impact: Gibbs continues to impress this season, tallying six touchdowns in his first three games of the season. He caught an 11-yard pass in the fourth quarter to put the Lions on top of the Jets to seal the win. Gibbs and the Lions will take on the Panthers in Week 4.

news.body: Jahmyr Gibbs rushed the ball 16 times for 52 yards and caught 6-of-8 targets for 61 yards and a touchdown in Thursday night's 41-31 loss to the Buffalo Bills.
news.head: Jahmyr Gibbs plays well in loss Thursday
news.impact: Thursday's game wasn't great for Gibbs in terms of efficiency, but he was still able to accumulate over 100 yards and a touchdown on Thursday night, which left him with a great fantasy total in this shootout matchup against the Bills. He will continue to be a top-tier fantasy option at the RB position for the remainder of the season, provided he remains healthy for most of it.

news.body: James Cook III rushed the ball 22 times for 95 yards and a touchdown and caught three passes for 58 yards in Sunday's 33-30 win over the Las Vegas Raiders.
news.head: James Cook III plays well in win Sunday
news.impact: Cook played great on Sunday. He finished with over 150 total yards and a touchdown against the Raiders, which helped to lead the Bills to a big win on the road. He should continue to be a top-tier fantasy asset for as long as he remains healthy and on the field moving forward.

news.body: James Cook III carried the ball 25 times for 111 yards and two touchdowns while catching his lone target for a seven-yard gain in a 37-34 overtime win over the Rams in Week 5.
news.head: James Cook III rushes for two TDs in Week 5
news.impact: Cook fumbled twice, losing one, on Monday night, but he still managed to post a dominant fantasy outing. The veteran running back rushed for touchdowns of 17 and five yards in the contest. He now has 532 rushing yards and five touchdowns on the season. Cook will be a strong RB1 in fantasy heading into Week 6 vs. the Raiders.

news.body: James Cook III rushed for 75 yards and a touchdown on 12 carries in the loss to the Patriots. He caught both of his targets for eight yards.
news.head: James Cook III finds the end zone in Week 4
news.impact: Cook averaged 6.3 yards per carry on his 12 carries, providing the Bills with an incredibly efficient effort. Despite the strong performance, his 12 rushing attempts are a new season low. Cook and the Bills will take on the Rams in Week 5.

news.body: James Cook III carried the ball 24 times for 154 yards and one touchdown with one fumble lost in the Bills' 24-16 Week 3 win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: James Cook III dominates on ground in Week 3 win over Chargers
news.impact: Cook III has been dynamic out of the backfield of late, rushing for over 130 yards with one touchdown in each of the last two contests. The running back remains an explosive RB1 option in all formats ahead of a Week 4 matchup with the New England Patriots.

news.body: Javonte Williams carried the ball 11 times for 41 yards and a touchdown while catching both of his targets for nine yards in a 23-13 loss to the Packers in Week 6.
news.head: Javonte Williams finds the end zone in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Williams was held to a season-low 11 carries with the Cowboys falling behind 17-0 at halftime. The veteran still managed to find the end zone, giving him eight all-purpose scores through six games. He will remain a locked-in RB1 in fantasy heading into Week 7 vs. the Eagles.

news.body: Javonte Williams ran 12 times for 45 yards and a touchdown in the Cowboys' 24-16 loss to Tampa Bay. He also caught two of three targets for 17 yards.
news.head: Javonte Williams shut down in loss to Bucs
news.impact: Williams had some early success on Thursday, culminating in his early touchdown plunge on the Cowboys' first drive. However, he didn't get much going after that, as the Dallas offense stalled completely until the fourth quarter. He's not particularly efficient, but the volume is there, and he should be a viable RB2 most weeks.

news.body: Javonte Williams ran for 62 yards on 19 carries with three touchdowns in the Cowboys 34-30 win over the Texans. He also caught 5-of-5 targets for 21 yards receiving.
news.head: Javonte Williams rushes for three touchdowns
news.impact: Williams didn't have the most efficient day on the ground, but he made up for it with three touchdowns and five receptions. He'll remain an RB1 play on Thursday against the Bucs.

news.body: Javonte Williams carried the ball 19 times for 98 yards and a touchdown while adding two catches for five yards in a 34-31 loss to the Ravens in Brazil in Week 3.
news.head: Javonte Williams finds the end zone in Week 3 loss
news.impact: Williams turned in another strong game on the ground for Dallas, finding the end zone on a two-yard run in the first quarter. The veteran tailback dominated the Dallas backfield, seeing all but six of the running-back carries. Williams has now rushed for 169 yards and two touchdowns while catching 10 passes for 56 yards and another touchdown through the air this season. He will be a solid RB1 in Week 4 against the Texans.

news.body: Jaylen Warren ran for 50 yards on 14 carries in the Steelers 26-19 win over the Buccaneers. He also caught 2-of-4 targets for 28 yards receiving.
news.head: Jaylen Warren sees 16 touches Sunday
news.impact: Warren was the lead back in the Steelers backfield in the fourth quarter and overtime period over Rico Dowdle. He'll remain an RB2 play next week against the Saints.

news.body: Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy labeled Jaylen Warren as the team's featured player when asked about the return of Rico Dowdle.
news.head: Jaylen Warren labeled 'featured player' by Steelers HC Mike McCarthy
news.impact: Warren has continued to play very well in the absence of Dowdle. Even when Dowdle makes his return, Warren will remain a steady RB2 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Jaylen Warren ran 15 times for 101 yards and a score while also grabbing all six of his targets for 87 yards and a score in the Steelers' 34-22 win over the Colts on Sunday.
news.head: Jaylen Warren gashes Colts defense in win
news.impact: Warren put on a clinic in this game, leading the Steelers in rushing (to be fair, he was the only rusher to have more than one carry, not counting kneel-downs) and receiving. He's been great while having the backfield to himself, but it sounds like Rico Dowdle will be back next week. He should still be a flex option when Dowdle returns, however.

news.body: Jaylen Warren rushed for 93 yards on 17 carries and caught 3-of-6 targets for 33 yards in Thursday's 27-24 loss to the Browns.
news.head: Jaylen Warren gains 126 yards of offense Thursday night
news.impact: With backfield mate Rico Dowdle (toe) sidelined again, Warren took advantage of a workhorse load for the second straight game. He has yet to find the end zone this season, but Warren is averaging an elite 5.6 yards per carry while gaining over 300 yards on the ground through four games. He has also hauled in 13 of 19 targets for better than 35 yards per game. Warren is locked in as an RB2, especially in PPR formats.

news.body: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) has been ruled out for Week 7 for the Arizona Cardinals according to Bo Brack.
news.head: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) ruled out for Week 7
news.impact: Love will be sidelined once again for Arizona, with Tyler Allgeier in line for a featured backfield role against the Denver Broncos Sunday.

news.body: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) is expected to miss the Cardinals Week 7 contest against the Broncos.
news.head: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) expected to miss Week 7
news.impact: If Love misses Week 7, that would make it two weeks in a row he has missed due to a nagging ankle injury. Bam Knight was a surprise producer with Love out, rather than the assumed starter in Tyler Allgeier. If Love sits yet again, Knight seems like the preferred option if you have to pick one, but it’s a risky bet.

news.body: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) is not practicing for the Cardinals on Wednesday.
news.head: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) not practicing Wednesday
news.impact: The rookie missed Arizona's last game due to a persistent ankle issue that he's dealing with, and he is going to be held out of Wednesday's practice for the same reason. He may very well miss another game because of this issue, but we won't know for sure until later on in the week.

news.body: Cardinals head coach Mike LaFleur said RB Jeremiyah Love will get "some running in" on Tuesday.
news.head: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) to get 'some running in' Tuesday
news.impact: Love missed Sunday's win over the Rams. The Cardinals will have a better idea of where he’s at and what he’ll do on Wednesday.

news.body: J.K. Dobbins ran 17 times for 41 yards and a touchdown in Denver's 17-14 win over Seattle on Thursday. He also caught three passes for five yards.
news.head: J.K. Dobbins punches in touchdown in win
news.impact: Dobbins wasn't overly efficient in this game, with his long run of 16 yards meaning his other 16 carries went for 25 yards. Still, a touchdown and a few receptions can cover a multitude of sins. He's a volume-based RB3 moving forward.

news.body: J.K. Dobbins ran for 68 yards and a touchdown on 18 carries, adding six yards on two receptions in Sunday's 23-17 win over the Chargers.
news.head: J.K. Dobbins finds the end zone in Week 5 win
news.impact: Dobbins scored his first touchdown of the season Sunday afternoon. The veteran back also set new season highs in touches and yards. Dobbins has not been very efficient this season, averaging just 3.6 yards on his nearly 13 carries per game, but he remains the workhorse in the Broncos' backfield. Dobbins has a tough matchup coming against the Seahawks in Week 6.

news.body: J.K. Dobbins rushed 11 times for 40 yards, while RJ Harvey had seven carries for 25 yards in Sunday's 24-14 loss to the San Francisco 49ers. Harvey also caught 10 passes for 68 yards out of the backfield.
news.head: J.K. Dobbins, RJ Harvey struggle in loss Sunday
news.impact: Denver couldn't get much going on the ground, with Dobbins and Harvey combining for just 65 rushing yards. Dobbins, however, continued to handle more of the rushing work. Harvey, meanwhile, was much more involved as a receiver and ended up leading the Broncos' offense in both receptions and receiving yards. The backfield remains a split, with Dobbins having the better chance at early-down work and Harvey carrying more upside in the passing game.

news.body: J.K. Dobbins is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the 49ers.
news.head: J.K. Dobbins (hip) off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Dobbins will remain a touchdown dependent low-end RB2 play for fantasy managers.

news.body: Jonathan Taylor ran 21 times for 94 yards and a touchdown while also bringing in two of four targets for 57 yards in the Colts' 26-20 loss to the Titans on Sunday.
news.head: Jonathan Taylor runs for 94 yards in loss
news.impact: Taylor has been one of the few bright spots in what has been a bad season so far for the Colts. He's been a touchdown machine this year and the primary option of the offense. Expect that to continue, and the fantasy points to roll in.

news.body: Jonathan Taylor ran 15 times for 45 yards and caught three of four targets for 37 yards in the Colts' 34-22 loss to the Steelers on Sunday.
news.head: Jonathan Taylor limited in loss to Steelers
news.impact: Taylor was largely bottled up by the Steelers' run defense, finding little running room outside of a 20-yard run near the end of the game. He had a nice catch-and-run in the receiving game, but those were his two explosive plays in the game. He will hope for better results next week against the Titans.

news.body: Jonathan Taylor rushed for 95 yards and two touchdowns on 20 carries in the win over the Commanders. He caught 1-of-4 targets for two yards.
news.head: Jonathan Taylor finds the end zone twice in Week 4 win
news.impact: Taylor found the end zone on a pair of five-yard touchdown runs in the second and third quarter. Taylor's strong 2026 season continues, as he has three multi-touchdown games in the team's first four games. Taylor and the Colts will take on the Steelers in Week 5.

news.body: Jonathan Taylor rushed for 68 yards on 23 carries in a 19-17 win over Houston. He caught 2-of-3 targets for four yards.
news.head: Jonathan Taylor held in check in Week 3 win
news.impact: Taylor continues to receive plenty of touches in the Colts' offense this season, but struggled to make the most of them in Week 3. His 72 total yards are a season low for Taylor. He will look to bounce back against the Commanders in Week 4.

news.body: Jordan Mason (thumb) logged a full practice session on Wednesday.
news.head: Jordan Mason (thumb) logs full practice Wednesday
news.impact: Mason seems to be trending the right direction for Week 7, as he was not limited in any way in his first official practice back on Wednesday. If he plays and has no workload restrictions this week, fantasy managers should consider starting him in a favorable matchup against the Colts.

news.body: Jordan Mason (thumb) is set to take part in Minnesota's practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Jordan Mason (thumb) set to practice Wednesday
news.impact: Minnesota recently opened Mason's 21-day practice window, and he is expected to participate in Wednesday's practice to some capacity. It looks like he will have a good chance to make his return to the lineup this week, but fantasy managers should continue to monitor all updates about his health leading up to Week 7.

news.body: The Vikings designed Jordan Mason to return from injured reserve.
news.head: Jordan Mason (thumb) designated to return to practice
news.impact: Mason will return to practice this week. He remains hopeful to return in Week 7 on Sunday.

news.body: Vikings RB Jordan Mason is expected to return for Minnesota’s Week 7 game.
news.head: Jordan Mason (thumb) expected to return in Week 7
news.impact: Mason is expected to return after the Vikings bye week. He will figure to return to a committee with Aaron Jones.

news.body: Packers head coach Matt LaFleur said he is undecided on whether or not Josh Jacobs will play in Week 7 against the Lions.
news.head: Josh Jacobs uncertain on availability for Week 7
news.impact: LaFleur said Jacobs will practice all week as he was removed from the commissioner exempt list.

news.body: Packers RB Josh Jacobs is being removed from the NFL’s Commissioner Exempt list on Monday.
news.head: Josh Jacobs to be removed from Commissioner Exempt list Monday
news.impact: Schefter notes the investigation will remain open for the NFL so it "reserves the right to add further discipline if and when warranted." For now, Jacobs will be eligible to return in Week 7. He'll likely be eased back by the Packers.

news.body: Green Bay Packers running back Josh Jacobs had his initial court appearance moved up to Sept. 10 from Nov. 17 regarding Jacobs' misdemeanor charges.
news.head: Josh Jacobs has court appearance date moved up
news.impact: Jacobs was charged with battery and criminal destruction of property and is scheduled to appear at the Brown County courthouse on Sept. 10, multiple days before Green Bay's season opener against Minnesota. It is unclear how this will affect his return timeline; Jacobs is currently on the commissioner's exempt list, with a potential suspension looming.

news.body: Packers GM Brian Gutekunst said he expected Josh Jacobs to play for the team in 2026.
news.head: Josh Jacobs expected to play for Packers in 2026 per GM
news.impact: Gutekunst said he wants to let the process play out when asked if there’s a scenario in which the Packers release Jacobs. He was placed on the Commissioners Exempt List on Sunday. This will remain a situation to monitor.

news.body: Kendre Miller ran for 70 yards on 20 carries in the Saints 34-27 win over the Giants.
news.head: Kendre Miller sees 20 carries Sunday
news.impact: Miller also caught both of his targets for zero yards receiving. He was once again the workhorse on the ground. He'll be a touchdown dependent RB2 next week against the Steelers.

news.body: Kendre Miller carried the ball 10 times for 30 yards and one touchdown in the Saints' 23-13 Week 5 loss to the Minnesota Vikings.
news.head: Kendre Miller reaches end zone in Week 5 loss to Vikings
news.impact: Miller has made minimal impact out of the New Orleans backfield to this point, rushing for less than 40 yards in each of his four contests. The running back remains difficult to trust in all formats ahead of a Week 6 matchup against the New York Giants.

news.body: Kendre Miller rushed the ball six times for just nine yards and lost a fumble in Monday night's 45-24 loss to the Atlanta Falcons.
news.head: Kendre Miller struggles in loss Monday
news.impact: Miller had a bad game on Monday night. He totaled just 19 yards on the ground and through the air against the Falcons, and he also lost a costly fumble, which further hurt his fantasy total. He should not be started in any fantasy league formats moving forward, especially with Alvin Kamara still seeing the bulk of the work in New Orleans' backfield right now.

news.body: Kendre Miller ran for 14 yards on four carries in the Saints 35-27 loss against the Raiders on Sunday. He also caught 2-of-3 targets for five yards receiving.
news.head: Kendre Miller sees four carries Sunday
news.impact: Miller saw some opportunity with Travis Etienne Jr. exiting early. Alvin Kamara was still the lead back in that span.

news.body: Kenneth Walker III rushed 19 times for 128 yards and two touchdowns while catching two of three targets for 11 yards in the Chiefs' 22-6 win over the Chargers.
news.head: Kenneth Walker III Runs for 128 Yards, Two TDs in Week 6
news.impact: Walker scored from 33 and two yards out while averaging 6.7 yards per carry. He also accounted for 19 of the Chiefs' 27 rushing attempts. There isn't much to question with that combination of workload and production. Walker remains a high-end RB1 going forward.

news.body: Kenneth Walker III carried the ball 22 times for 177 yards and two touchdowns while catching his lone target for a two-yard gain in a 30-27 win over the Raiders in Week 4.
news.head: Kenneth Walker III runs for 177 yards, two TDs in Week 4
news.impact: Walker notched his third multi-touchdown game of the season in what has been an impressive start to the year. The veteran running back found the end zone on rushes of two and 22 yards in the win. Overall, Walker has 537 rushing yards and six all-purpose touchdowns on the year. A locked-in high-end RB1 the rest of the way, he will be on bye in Week 5 before taking on the Chargers in Week 6.

news.body: Kenneth Walker III carried the ball 18 times for 70 yards and one touchdown while also catching both of his targets for three yards and one touchdown in the Chiefs' 24-10 Week 3 win over the Miami Dolphins.
news.head: Kenneth Walker III reaches end zone twice in Week 3 win over Dolphins
news.impact: Walker III has gotten off to an impactful start to the season out of the Kansas City backfield, recording multiple touchdowns in two of the first three contests. The running back remains a dynamic option as part of a revamped Chiefs offensive attack for head coach Andy Reid, with a Week 4 divisional matchup against the Las Vegas Raiders up next.

news.body: Kenneth Walker III rushed the ball 24 times for 117 yards and caught 6-of-10 targets for 61 yards in Sunday night's 33-30 overtime win over the Indianapolis Colts.
news.head: Kenneth Walker III totals 178 yards in OT win Sunday
news.impact: Walker's hot start to the season continued on Sunday night. He totaled 178 yards from scrimmage in a big win over the Colts, and he was able to do that while maintaining terrific efficiency. He will continue to be a top-tier fantasy asset for as long as he remains healthy and on the field moving forward.

news.body: Kenny Gainwell ran for 17 yards on two carries in the Buccaneers 26-19 loss against the Steelers. He also caught his lone target for seven yards receiving.
news.head: Kenny Gainwell quiet Sunday
news.impact: Gainwell remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

news.body: Kenny Gainwell ran four times for 18 yards and caught three of four targets for 10 yards in the Bucs' 24-16 win over the Cowboys on Thursday.
news.head: Kenny Gainwell sees limited work on Thursday night
news.impact: Gainwell was fine on his rushing touches, but his receiving was a little lackluster. True, a play did get blown up on one of his receptions, but that's little comfort for his fantasy production. He is firmly the RB2 of the offense and should be treated as such.

news.body: Kenny Gainwell carried the ball three times for five yards and caught both of his targets for 22 yards and a touchdown in a 17-14 loss to the Packers in Week 4.
news.head: Kenny Gainwell catches TD in Week 4
news.impact: Gainwell found the end zone on a 10-yard pass from Jalon Daniels in the fourth quarter. It has been a quiet season thus far for Gainwell, who has just 26 rushing yards and eight catches for 44 yards through four games. He will be a low-end flex option in Week 5 vs. the Cowboys.

news.body: Kenny Gainwell ran for -4 yards on three carries in the Buccaneers 23-16 loss against the Vikings on Sunday. He also caught 2-of-5 targets for 14 yards receiving.
news.head: Kenny Gainwell quiet again Sunday
news.impact: Gainwell was once again not involved much. It is worth noting Bucky Irving was on the sideline for most of the final quarter. The status of Irving will need to be monitored this week.

news.body: Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) has been ruled out for Thursday night's game against the New England Patriots.
news.head: Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) ruled out for Thursday
news.impact: Monangai is going to miss yet another game on Thursday night. He's still dealing with a pair of injuries, and it's unclear how much more time he will have to miss because of them. D'Andre Swift will continue to carry the load for Chicago's backfield against the Patriots, with Roschon Johnson also set for increased work as the fill-in RB2.

news.body: Kyle Monangai did not practice on Tuesday.
news.head: Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) misses practice Tuesday
news.impact: Monangai has still yet to practice. He is trending towards being sidelined again on Thursday against the Patriots.

news.body: Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) has officially been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Atlanta Falcons.
news.head: Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) officially out for Week 6
news.impact: As expected, Monangai has officially been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Falcons. He is reportedly considered week-to-week at this point, and fantasy managers should continue to expect D'Andre Swift and Roschon Johnson to serve as the team's top-two running backs in Monangai's continued absence.

news.body: Bears head coach Ben Johnson said Kyle Monangai remains week-to-week.
news.head: Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) remains week-to-week
news.impact: Monangai will remain sidelined this week. He is expected to avoid injured reserve.

news.body: Kyren Williams rushed the ball ten times for 50 yards and caught 3-of-6 targets for 17 yards in Sunday's 18-16 loss to the Arizona Cardinals.
news.head: Kyren Williams leads team in rushing Sunday
news.impact: Williams saw 16 opportunities on Sunday, but he was a bit disappointing with them, racking up 67 yards without a touchdown in the team's loss to the Cardinals. After the game he voiced some frustrations about the timeshare the team currently has in the backfield, but fantasy managers shouldn't be too concerned about him moving forward and should continue to start him without reservation for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Kyren Williams carried the ball 16 times for 49 yards and a touchdown while catching six of his eight targets for 27 yards in a 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills in Week 5.
news.head: Kyren Williams finds the end zone in Week 5
news.impact: Williams was mostly bottled up on the ground by the Buffalo defense on Monday night, but he still managed to punch in a one-yard TD run in the fourth quarter. The Rams' newfound willingness to use Williams in the passing attack this year has been an added bonus as he already has 27 catches through five games, putting him just nine grabs shy of setting a new career-high. Williams will be a locked-in RB1 in fantasy in Week 6 vs. the Cardinals.

news.body: Kyren Williams rushed the ball 16 times for 80 yards and two touchdowns and caught 10-of-13 targets for 67 yards in Sunday's 24-20 win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.head: Kyren Williams dominant in win Sunday
news.impact: Williams had a stellar game in Week 4. He led team with 80 rushing yards, found the end zone two different times, and caught ten passes for 67 yards through the air in Sunday's win over the Eagles. Fantasy managers should be well pleased with this performance and with the fact that he has entirely pulled ahead of Blake Corum in terms of touches in close matchups.

news.body: Kyren Williams rushed the ball 15 times for 88 yards and caught 6-of-7 targets for 70 yards in Sunday night's 30-26 loss to the Denver Broncos.
news.head: Kyren Williams stellar in loss Sunday
news.impact: Williams had a great showing on Sunday night. He was the team's leading rusher and maintained great efficiency at 5.9 yards per carry, and he was also very involved in the passing game with six catches for 70 yards over the course of the night. He will likely continue to serve as the team's RB1 for the foreseeable future, even more so in close matchups like this one was.

news.body: MarShawn Lloyd carried the ball eight times for 10 yards and failed to catch his lone target in a 23-13 win over the Cowboys in Week 6.
news.head: MarShawn Lloyd held to 10 yards in Week 6 win
news.impact: LLoyd scored two touchdowns in Week 5 but he took a backseat to Pierre Strong against Dallas. The veteran has now rushed 48 times for just 122 yards and two touchdowns while adding 10 catches for 55 yards and a score through six games. He will be tough to trust, even as a flex option, in Week 7 vs. the Lions.

news.body: MarShawn Lloyd carried the ball 10 times for 31 yards and two touchdowns while also catching one of his two targets for six yards in the Packers' 31-7 Week 5 win over the Chicago Bears.
news.head: MarShawn Lloyd rushes for two touchdowns in Week 5 win
news.impact: Lloyd has made minimal impact as the primary option in the Green Bay backfield to begin the season, rushing for less than 40 yards in each of the first five games. The running back remains difficult to trust despite his No. 1 role ahead of a Week 6 matchup against the Dallas Cowboys.

news.body: MarShawn Lloyd carried the ball seven times for 13 yards and caught all five of his targets for 36 yards in a 17-14 win over Tampa Bay in Week 4.
news.head: MarShawn Lloyd catches five passes in Week 4
news.impact: Lloyd struggled on the ground but he did some damage via the passing attack in the close win. The Packers continued with their three-man attack in the backfield with Kaleb Johnson getting eight carries and Chris Brooks four. No one has been able to find success running the ball in Green Bay this season, however. Lloyd will be a low-end flex option heading into Week 5 against the Bears.

news.body: MarShawn Lloyd ran four times for 11 yards and caught two of three targets for seven yards in the Packers' 35-14 loss to the Falcons.
news.head: MarShawn Lloyd snags two passes in loss
news.impact: Lloyd wasn't all that impressive in this game, but he was better than Kaleb Johnson this time out. The backfield is a mess right now with Josh Jacobs out, and everyone is struggling to run. Expect both Lloyd and Johnson to be irrelevant for fantasy moe often than not.

news.body: Ollie Gordon II rushed the ball 18 times for 88 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 31-24 loss to the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.head: Ollie Gordon II finds end zone Sunday
news.impact: Gordon was Miami's leading rusher on Sunday, finishing with 88 yards and a touchdown while maintaining an efficient clip of 4.9 yards per carry. He saw no opportunities in the receiving game, however, which severely hindered his upside. That will be a problem for his week-to-week consistency moving forward if the team makes no efforts to get him involved as a receiver.

news.body: Ollie Gordon II rushed the ball nine times for 100 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 15-10 loss to the Minnesota Vikings.
news.head: Ollie Gordon II plays well in loss Sunday
news.impact: Gordon was one of the only bright spots for Miami's offense this week. He finished with 100 yards and a touchdown on just nine carries, which left him with a great efficiency number in this game. He has clearly separated himself from Jaylen Wright in terms of talent and output, but they continue to be somewhat close together in terms of opportunities, which could limit Gordon moving forward.

news.body: Dolphins coach Jeff Hafley said all running backs on the roster are “going to have their roles.”
news.head: Ollie Gordon II: All RBs on Dolphins 'are going to have their roles'
news.impact: Gordon remains the most likely player to lead the backfield, but Jaylen Wright will figure to have a role when he is healthy. Gordon can be viewed as a borderline RB2 for now.

news.body: Ollie Gordon II carried the ball 17 times for 41 yards and one touchdown while also hauling in all three of his targets for 14 yards in the Dolphins' 24-10 Week 3 loss to the Kansas City Chiefs.
news.head: Ollie Gordon II reaches end zone in Week 3 loss to Chiefs
news.impact: Gordon II took advantage of increased touches with De'Von Achane (knee) exiting early for head coach Jeff Hafley, posting more than three touches for the first time in three contests Sunday. The running back is in line to take over a No. 1 running back role with Achane expected to be sidelined for a significant amount of time according to Hafley, with a tough Week 4 matchup against the Minnesota Vikings up next.

news.body: Omarion Hampton rushed seven times for 18 yards while catching all four of his targets for 21 yards in the Chargers' 22-6 loss to the Chiefs.
news.head: Omarion Hampton Totals 39 Yards in Week 6
news.impact: Hampton averaged just 2.6 yards per carry, but the bigger concern is the workload. Kimani Vidal also received seven carries and finished with seven touches compared to Hampton's 11. The four receptions helped Hampton in PPR formats, but a split backfield on an 0-6 offense isn't an ideal fantasy situation.

news.body: Omarion Hampton gained only 33 yards on 14 carries, adding a six-yard reception during Sunday's 23-17 loss to the Broncos.
news.head: Omarion Hampton held under 40 yards on 15 touches
news.impact: Much to the chagrin of fantasy managers, Hampton continues to share the backfield load with Kimani Vidal and Keaton Mitchell. Hampton had at least found the end zone in three of the first four weeks, but he failed to do so in Week 5. The second-year back is averaging only 3.7 yards on his nearly 15 carries per game, and he's basically become an afterthought in the Chargers' passing attack.

news.body: Omarion Hampton ran for 45 yards and a touchdown on nine carries in the Chargers 30-23 loss against the Seahawks. He also caught 2-of-2 targets for eight yards receiving.
news.head: Omarion Hampton finds the end zone Sunday
news.impact: Hampton saw just nine carries to 15 combined carries between Keaton Mitchell and Kimani Vidal. Hampton is a touchdown dependent flex play moving forward.

news.body: Omarion Hampton carried the ball 15 times for 56 yards while also failing to catch his lone target in the Chargers' 24-16 Week 3 loss to the Buffalo Bills.
news.head: Omarion Hampton leads ground attack in Week 3 loss to Bills
news.impact: Hampton struggled to find consistent running room Sunday, rushing for less than 60 yards for the second time in the first three contests. The running back remains one of the more reliable options as part of an inconsistent Chargers offense to begin the season, with a Week 4 contest against the Seattle Seahawks up next.

news.body: Quinshon Judkins (ankle) is off of the injury report for Week 7 for the Cleveland Browns according to Mary Kay Cabot.
news.head: Quinshon Judkins (ankle) off injury report for Week 7
news.impact: Judkins is good to go after increasing reps in practice throughout the week for head coach Todd Monken, setting the running back up to lead a Cleveland backfield that could be missing Dylan Sampson (knee) against the Titans Sunday.

news.body: Quinshon Judkins practiced on Thursday.
news.head: Quinshon Judkins (ankle) practices Thursday
news.impact: Judkins is on track to be good to go for Sunday's game against the Titans. His status will need to be monitored in practice on Friday.

news.body: Quinshon Judkins (ankle) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Quinshon Judkins (ankle) limited at practice Wednesday
news.impact: The young running back missed last week's game due to an ankle issue, but he is limited to start practice this week and seems to have a real chance to play in Week 7. Jaleel McLaughlin and Audric Estime will both see less work if that's the case.

news.body: Browns coach Todd Monken said he's optimistic RB Quinshon Judkins will be able to play on Sunday against the Titans.
news.head: Quinshon Judkins (ankle) optimistic for Week 7
news.impact: Judkins was sidelined last week. He will need to be monitored in practice throughout the week.
