news.body: Omar Cooper Jr. caught 6-of-7 targets for 103 yards and a touchdown in the 26-19 loss to the Patriots.
news.head: Omar Cooper Jr. finds the end zone in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Cooper led the team in all receiving categories in the loss Sunday. Cooper had been out of action for the last four games with a high-ankle sprain. Cooper will look to continue to build rapport with QB Geno Smith in Week 7 against Miami.

news.body: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) will return for the Jets on Sunday against the Patriots.
news.head: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) to return in Week 6
news.impact: Cooper has not played since he was knocked out of the Jets' season opener with a sprained ankle. The first-round rookie has returned to limited practice sessions this week, and it was announced Friday morning that he's ready for in-game action. With Adonai Mitchell (finger) remaining out this week, Cooper should slot right in behind Garrett Wilson at wide receiver for the Jets. However, there is certainly a chance that Cooper is eased back into the mix as far as total snaps go.

news.body: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) logged a limited practice session on Thursday.
news.head: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) logs limited practice Thursday
news.impact: The rookie was able to participate in Thursday's practice in a limited fashion. He is drawing close to a return from the ankle injury that left him on injured reserve, but it's still unclear whether or not his return will come in time for Sunday's divisional matchup against the Patriots.

news.body: Omar Cooper Jr. practiced again on Thursday.
news.head: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) practices Thursday
news.impact: Cooper was designated to return to practice on Wednesday where he was limited. It is unclear if he has a chance to return on Sunday.

news.body: Parker Washington caught 4-of-11 targets for 64 yards in the Jaguars' 34-31 loss to the Texans.
news.head: Parker Washington held to four receptions in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Washington led the team in targets, but was unable to do much with them. He finished behind Jakobi Meyers in receptions and receiving yards in the loss, and could not find the end zone despite Trevor Lawrence tossing four touchdowns. Washington will look to rest up in the bye week and bounce back in Week 8.

news.body: Parker Washington brought down 6-of-9 targets for 124 yards and a pair of touchdowns in Sunday's 19-17 win over the Eagles.
news.head: Parker Washington rebounds with huge performance in Week 5
news.impact: Washington eclipsed the 100-yard mark for the first time this season on Sunday, doubling his touchdown total for the season in the process. He looked every bit the part of a dynamic WR1 on Sunday. However, the Jaguars have a plethora of talented pass catchers, and QB Trevor Lawrence does tend to spread the ball around. Still, Washington is a potent fantasy option.

news.body: Parker Washington caught 1-of-3 targets for just seven yards in Sunday's 22-17 win over the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.head: Parker Washington held to one catch Sunday
news.impact: Washington had a total disappearing act on Sunday. He was held to just one catch for a measly seven yards against the Bengals after starting out the first three weeks of the season as a red-hot fantasy option. He should bounce back and return to being a quality starter very quickly, but seeing this kind of floor for the veteran was unexpected and not ideal for fantasy managers.

news.body: Parker Washington hauled in 3-of-5 targets for 40 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 35-6 win over the New England Patriots.
news.head: Parker Washington hauls in touchdown Sunday
news.impact: Washington was slightly underwhelming in terms of receptions and yardage on Sunday, but he was able to find the end zone against New England, which left him with a nice fantasy total once again. He has been very good to start the season and should continue to be started in nearly all leagues for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Puka Nacua (calf) is questionable for the Rams game against the Raiders with a calf injury.
news.head: Puka Nacua (calf) questionable for Sunday
news.impact: While the calf injury was originally reported to be minor, it seems like that might have been a flat out lie. Puka could still be just fine and see a boatload of targets, but the certainty of his availability just took a big hit. Fantasy managers will need to keep a close eye on his status, especially as his game is in the late afternoon window.

news.body: Puka Nacua left practice early on Thursday due to a calf injury.
news.head: Puka Nacua leaves practice early on Thursday due to calf injury
news.impact: The already injury riddled Rams might have another one to deal with, this time their superstar wideout. With Davante Adams already out, and Terrance Ferguson not ready to return, the team is running short of capable pass catchers. If Puka misses time expect Tyler Higbee and Kyren Williams to see additional work.

news.body: Puka Nacua hauled in 6-of-7 targets for 80 yards in Sunday's 18-16 loss to the Arizona Cardinals.
news.head: Puka Nacua leads team in receiving Sunday
news.impact: Nacua was a bright spot for the Rams on Sunday. He led the team with 80 yards over the course of the day, though he wasn't able to get into the end zone at all to put the cherry on top. Still, fantasy managers should be content with his performance and should expect him to continue to be an elite fantasy asset moving forward.

news.body: Puka Nacua caught 17 of his 24 targets for 138 yards and a touchdown while rushing twice for nine yards in a 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills in Week 5.
news.head: Puka Nacua draws 24 targets in Week 5 loss
news.impact: Nacua drew an insane 24 targets, putting him third all-time in a single game in the NFL behind only Brandon Marshall (28) and Chris Chambers (26). The veteran wideout also found the end zone on a two-yard pass from Matthew Stafford in the fourth quarter. Nacua now has 31 catches for 337 yards and one touchdown in just three games this season. He will be a top-three fantasy WR in Week 6 vs. the Cardinals.

news.body: Rashee Rice (hamstring/knee) is out for the Chiefs Week 7 game against the Seahawks on Sunday.
news.head: Rashee Rice (hamstring/knee) out for Week 7
news.impact: Rice will miss a second straight game due to injury, leaving Xavier Worthy, Jalen Royals, and Cyrus Allen to face off against the Seattle Seahawks secondary. Worthy should at least get some short area PPR scam targets, making him a flex option, but the other receivers are not reliable enough to start as of this moment.

news.body: Rashee Rice did not practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Rashee Rice (hamstring/knee) officially misses practice Wednesday
news.impact: Rice is on the injury report with hamstring and knee issues. His status will need to be monitored in practice on Thursday and Friday.

news.body: Rashee Rice will not practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Rashee Rice (hamstring) not practicing Wednesday
news.impact: Rice remained sidelined last week after injuring his hamstring before the Chiefs bye week. His status will need to continue to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

news.body: Rashee Rice has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chargers.
news.head: Rashee Rice (hamstring) ruled out Sunday
news.impact: Rice was unable to practice all week. It will be Xavier Worthy, Jalen Royals and Cyrus Allen leading the Chiefs wide receiver room.

news.body: Rashid Shaheed was limited in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Rashid Shaheed (hip) limited in practice Wednesday
news.impact: Shaheed remains on the WR4/WR5 range for fantasy managers.

news.body: Rashid Shaheed caught five of eight targets for 66 yards in the Seahawks' 17-14 loss to Denver on Thursday. He also caught a two-point conversion and fumbled twice, losing one of them.
news.head: Rashid Shaheed snags five passes in loss
news.impact: Shaheed struggled at times in this game with ball security, but also had some nice grabs downfield and in the short area. It's a bit of a mixed bag for the veteran, but hopefully this is a sign of more involvement in the passing game and Shaheed becoming more of a viable WR2 in Seattle. Granted, Sam Darnold threw 51 passes, so the 8 targets only amounted to a 15.6% target share, but we will take what we can get.

news.body: Rashid Shaheed caught 2-of-4 targets for 23 yards in the Seahawks 32-29 loss against the 49ers.
news.head: Rashid Shaheed catches two passes Sunday
news.impact: Shaheed remains off the fantasy radar in his current role. The Seahawks passing offense remains Jaxon Smith-Njigba or no one every week right now.

news.body: Rashid Shaheed caught 1-of-3 targets for 20 yards in the Seahawks 30-23 win over the Chargers. He also saw two carries for 33 yards and a touchdown.
news.head: Rashid Shaheed scores touchdown on ground Sunday
news.impact: With Jadarian Price on IR, Emanuel Wilson was the workhorse in the Seahawks backfield. Shaheed saw two traditional handoffs from Sam Darnold with one of them resulting in a 28-yard touchdown. He remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

news.body: Rome Odunze secured 4-of-5 targets for 69 yards in Thursday's 30-24 win over the Patriots.
news.head: Rome Odunze hauls in four passes Thursday night
news.impact: Odunze seems to still be third in the pecking order of Bears pass catchers behind TE Colston Loveland and fellow wideout Luther Burden. Still, Odunze turned in a solid effort Thursday night. Over the last two games with QB Caleb Williams back at the helm of the offense, Odunze has come up with 7-of-9 targets for 108 yards. The third-year pro has 24 receptions with an average of 15.9 yards per catch through seven games.

news.body: Rome Odunze caught three of his four targets for 39 yards in the Bears' 31-23 Week 6 win over the Atlanta Falcons.
news.head: Rome Odunze quiet in Week 6 win over Falcons
news.impact: Odunze has struggled to make a sizeable impact in the Chicago offense of late, recording less than 50 receiving yards in four of the last five contests. The wideout remains difficult to trust for fantasy managers in all formats ahead of a Week 7 matchup against the New England Patriots.

news.body: Rome Odunze hauled in three of his team-leading nine targets for 40 yards with a fumble lost in the Bears' 31-7 Week 5 loss to the Green Bay Packers.
news.head: Rome Odunze sees nine targets in Week 5 loss
news.impact: Odunze has struggled to make a consistent impact in the Chicago passing attack, finishing with less than 60 receiving yards in four of five contests. The wideout remains a risky pass-catching option in all formats ahead of a Week 6 matchup against the Atlanta Falcons.

news.body: Rome Odunze caught six of his seven targets for 94 yards in a 23-12 win over the Jets in Week 4.
news.head: Rome Odunze goes for 94 yards in Week 4
news.impact: Odunze led the Bears in all receiving categories in what was his best game of the season. The veteran receiver has now caught 14 passes for 233 yards and no touchdowns through four games. Odunze will be a low-end WR3 in fantasy in Week 5 vs. the Packers.

news.body: Romeo Doubs (shoulder) is facing an uncertain timetable to return, per HC Mike Vrabel. When asked about Doubs and when he might come back into the lineup, Vrabel was uncertain and non-commital on a timeline, stating “I’m not sure how long that (his IR stint) will be.”
news.head: Romeo Doubs (shoulder) facing uncertain timetable to retun
news.impact: It’s a rough situation for Doubs, who was putting up a big game before going out with a shoulder injury. He’s not droppable jet yet, at least not in leagues with an IR slot. However, he seems to be right on the edge of drop territory, so fantasy managers will need to keep an eye out for any updates regarding his potential return. However, it’s not looking very promising as of writing.

news.body: The Patriots placed Romeo Doubs on injured reserve.
news.head: Romeo Doubs (shoulder) placed on IR
news.impact: Doubs left Sunday's game early in the third quarter. He will now miss at least the next four games.

news.body: Romeo Doubs caught his lone target for a 42-yard touchdown in the Patriots' 26-19 win over the Jets.
news.head: Romeo Doubs (shoulder) finds the end zone in Week 6
news.impact: Doubs suffered the injury on the touchdown catch in which he landed hard diving for the ball. His status will be worth monitoring ahead of a Thursday night matchup with the Bears.

news.body: Patriots WR Romeo Doubs (shoulder) is questionable to return Sunday against the Jets.
news.head: Romeo Doubs (shoulder) questionable to return
news.impact: Doubs appeared to suffer the shoulder injury on his touchdown reception in the first quarter. The Patriots should update his status after halftime.

news.body: Ryan Flournoy caught seven of his nine targets for 40 yards and a touchdown in a 23-13 loss to the Packers in Week 6.
news.head: Ryan Flournoy finds the end zone in Week 6
news.impact: Flournoy turned in a solid game while operating as the Cowboys' No. 3 receiver. He caught Dak Prescott's lone touchdown on a six-yard pass with 44 seconds left in the contest. Flournoy now has 23 catches for 234 yards and one touchdown through six contests this year. He will be a decent flex in fantasy in Week 7 vs. the Eagles.

news.body: Ryan Flournoy caught three of four targets for 90 yards in the Cowboys' 24-16 loss to the Bucs on Thursday.
news.head: Ryan Flournoy goes for 90 yards in loss
news.impact: Flournoy stepped in and made some big plays while operating as the Cowboys' WR2/3 on Thursday with CeeDee Lamb in and out of the lineup due to injury. If Lamb or George Pickens were to miss any time, Flournoy would be a primary pickup.

news.body: Ryan Flournoy caught 4-of-5 targets for 37 yards in the Cowboys 34-30 win over the Texans on Sunday.
news.head: Ryan Flournoy hauls in four passes Sunday
news.impact: Flournoy continues to have a limited role in the offense for Dallas. He is a WR4 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Ryan Flournoy caught two of his eight targets for 22 yards in a 34-31 loss to the Ravens in Brazil in Week 3.
news.head: Ryan Flournoy draws eight targets in Week 3
news.impact: Flournoy didn't do much damage through the air but he drew an encouraging eight targets in the loss. If he can continue to get that type of work consistently, Flournoy might work his way into the flex conversation in fantasy leagues. For now, he's best left on the bench heading into a Week 4 matchup against a tough Houston Texans defense.

news.body: Stefon Diggs caught six of his seven targets for 44 yards and a touchdown in a 23-17 loss to the 49ers in Week 6's Monday night game.
news.head: Stefon Diggs scores TD in Week 6
news.impact: Diggs set a season-high in catches for the Commanders in the close loss to San Francisco. He found the end zone for the fourth time this season on a one-yard pass from Jayden Daniels late in the third quarter. Diggs should remain a key piece of the Washington passing attack, especially after Terry McLaurin had to be carted off the field with a knee injury on Monday night. The Commanders are on bye in Week 7 before they take on the Eagles in Week 8. Diggs can be considered a solid flex option in fantasy going forward.

news.body: Stefon Diggs (hamstring) is officially active for Week 6 for the Washington Commanders according to Adam Schefter.
news.head: Stefon Diggs (hamstring) active for Week 6

news.body: Stefon Diggs is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the 49ers.
news.head: Stefon Diggs (hamstring) listed questionable Monday
news.impact: Diggs returned to practice on Friday. He'll be a game-time decision on Monday, but he seems to be trending in the right direction.

news.body: Stefon Diggs was seen practicing on Friday.
news.head: Stefon Diggs (hamstring) seen at practice Friday
news.impact: It is a positive sign for Diggs after he missed practice on Thursday to open the week. He'll have one more day to practice on Saturday ahead of Monday's game against the 49ers.

news.body: Ted Hurst III caught 3-of-6 targets for 40 yards in the Buccaneers 26-19 loss against the Steelers.
news.head: Ted Hurst III totals 40 yards Sunday
news.impact: Hurst continues to act as a field stretcher for the Bucs on the outside. He has been helping their offense, but he remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

news.body: Ted Hurst III caught two of his three targets for 25 yards in a 17-14 loss to the Packers in Week 4.
news.head: Ted Hurst III goes for 25 yards in Week 4
news.impact: Hurst made a 21-yard catch early in the second quarter but would go on to post just one more catch for a four-yard gain in the loss. The rookie wideout has looked explosive in limited chances this season, catching eight passes for 128 yards and a touchdown through four games. He will face the Cowboys in Week 5.

news.body: Ted Hurst III caught 1-of-4 targets for 40 yards receiving and a touchdown in the Buccaneers 23-16 loss against the Vikings on Sunday.
news.head: Ted Hurst III hauls in deep touchdown Sunday
news.impact: Hurst caught a 40-yard deep ball from Baker Mayfield in the first half for a score. It was his lone catch on the day. The status of Mayfield will need to be monitored after he left late in the loss.

news.body: Ted Hurst III caught 2-of-7 targets for 27 yards in the Buccaneers 23-19 loss against the Browns.
news.head: Ted Hurst III sees seven targets Sunday
news.impact: Hurst led Tampa Bay in targets, but they did not result in much of anything production wise. He is on the upside WR4 radar right now for fantasy managers.

news.body: Tee Higgins caught 2-of-4 targets for just 22 yards in Sunday's 31-24 win over the Miami Dolphins.
news.head: Tee Higgins disappoints in win Sunday
news.impact: Higgins was dealing with several different injuries at practice throughout the week, but the team cleared him to play for Sunday's game. He didn't end up producing well, finishing with just 22 scoreless yards on two catches in a win over the Dolphins. He should have a good opportunity to get healthy during Cincinnati's bye week this week, however, so fantasy managers should expect him to bounce back after that.

news.body: Tee Higgins (groin/neck) will play for the Cincinnati Bengals against the Miami Dolphins Sunday according to Adam Schefter.
news.head: Tee Higgins (groin/neck) will play Sunday
news.impact: Higgins is good to go after entering the weekend with a questionable designation, joining Ja’Marr Chase (concussion) back in the Cincinnati passing attack against the Dolphins Sunday.

news.body: Tee Higgins is listed as questionable for Sunday’s game against the Dolphins.
news.head: Tee Higgins (groin/neck) listed questionable Sunday
news.impact: Higgins was able to get in some work during practice on Friday. His status will have to be monitored closer to kickoff on Sunday.

news.body: Tee Higgins is now running some routes with the Bengals in individual drills during practice on Friday.
news.head: Tee Higgins (groin/neck) now running routes in individual drills
news.impact: Higgins was not going through the stretch period to begin practice. His status will need to continue to be monitored.

news.body: Carolina Panthers wide receiver Tetairoa McMillan caught six passes for 86 yards in a Week 6 win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.head: Tetairoa McMillan gains 86 yards in Week 6 win
news.impact: McMillan has 75+ yards and 8+ targets in four of five games to start the season, a reliable floor in what has been a potent Carolina passing offense. He has not caught a touchdown yet with wide receiver Jalen Coker in the lineup, but McMillan's large frame and target rate indicate more could come in the future after scoring seven as a rookie.

news.body: Tetairoa McMillan collected 14 receptions on 16 targets for 192 yards and a pair of touchdowns in Sunday's 32-26 win over the Lions.
news.head: Tetairoa McMillan shreds Lions secondary Sunday night
news.impact: For those frustrated by McMillan's paltry output in Week 3, the second-year star erupted for career highs in receptions and yards Sunday night. He also recorded the second multi-touchdown game of his career. It's important to note that this performance came with both Jalen Coker (quad) and Xavier Legette (knee) out, but McMillan still displayed his immense upside. He's a solid WR2 for fantasy purposes at present.

news.body: Tetairoa McMillan caught 2-of-5 targets for just 17 yards in Sunday's 21-18 loss to the Cleveland Browns.
news.head: Tetairoa McMillan disappears in loss Sunday
news.impact: McMillan got shut down on Sunday. He was only able to catch two passes for just 17 yards against the Browns, despite being the team's clear WR1 after Jalen Coker (quad) left the game. He should bounce back in the near future, but it's possible that his week-to-week floor will be lower than managers hoped coming into the season.

news.body: Tetairoa McMillan caught 5 of 10 targets for 101 yards in the Panthers' 34-3 win over the Falcons on Sunday.
news.head: Tetairoa McMillan leads Panthers receivers in win
news.impact: McMillan's ten targets led the team, with Jalen Coker falling close behind with nine. It's a bummer he didn't connect on more than five, as he could have had a much bigger day. He and Coker are forming a formidable receiving duo in Carolina, and both are startable every week.

news.body: Tre Tucker caught 5-of-7 targets for 97 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 33-30 loss to the Buffalo Bills.
news.head: Tre Tucker stellar in loss Sunday
news.impact: Tucker had a stellar performance on Sunday. He led the team with 97 yards over the course of the afternoon and he was also able to get into the end zone on two occasions, which left him with a great fantasy total on the day. Fantasy managers should consider picking him up if he's available on the waiver wire, as the team may very well try to get him more involved on a week-to-week basis after this game.

news.body: Tre Tucker recorded four receptions on five targets for 41 yards in the Raiders loss to the Patriots. He lost six yards on two rushes in the lost.
news.head: Tre Tucker hauls in four passes in Week 5
news.impact: Tucker led the wide receiver group in targets, but fell behind Brock Bowers and Ashton Jeanty in receptions and yardage. Tucker is likely a volatile option in a Week 6 matchup with Buffalo.

news.body: Tre Tucker caught four of his eight targets for 44 yards in a 30-27 loss to the Chiefs in Week 4.
news.head: Tre Tucker goes for 44 yards in Week 4
news.impact: Tucker tied for third on the team with his eight targets in a game where Kirk Cousins attempted 52 passes. Tucker has been a solid fantasy option this season, posting 15 catches for 233 yards and a touchdown through four games. He will be a fantasy flex in Week 5 vs. the Patriots.

news.body: Tre Tucker caught 4-of-4 targets for 43 yards in the Raiders 35-27 win over the Saints on Sunday.
news.head: Tre Tucker hauls in four passes Sunday
news.impact: Tucker led Raiders wide receivers in receptions and yards. Still his upside remains limited for fantasy managers.

news.body: Tyreek Hill’s agent Drew Rosenhaus said he remains in talks with multiple NFL teams.
news.head: Tyreek Hill remains in talks with multiple teams
news.impact: Hill continues to rehab his surgically repaired knee. Rosenhaus added that “nothing is imminent at this time.” He remains without a clear timetable to sign and return.

news.body: Tyreek Hill is expected to sign with a team in the coming days, per his agent. He’s been linked to the Chiefs, but other teams are in the mix.
news.head: Tyreek Hill expected to sign in the coming days
news.impact: Hill could give the Chiefs some depth, but it will be interesting to see how much of an impact he could make at this stage of his career while also coming off of a major knee injury. He’s worth stashing, but keep expectations low.

news.body: Tyreek Hill is not expected to sign with a team before the season begins, according to his agent Drew Rosenhaus.
news.head: Tyreek Hill not expected to sign before Week 1
news.impact: Hill has been on the long road to recovery after sustaining a major knee injury in Week 4 last season, and it looks like he will remain a free agent when the 2026 season begins. However, the 32-year-old could receive interest from contenders as the season goes on if he continues to progress in his rehab.

news.body: Tyreek Hill says that he still has “no power” in his left leg that he injured early on in 2025 while playing for the Miami Dolphins. The free agent receiver still has a ways to go before playing football again.
news.head: Tyreek Hill says he still has ‘no power’ in left leg
news.impact: Hill suffered a gruesome knee dislocation and multiple ligament tears in Week 4 of 2025, missing the rest of the season. It’s a big blow to his chances of finding a team and making his way back onto the field in 2026, especially if he is still struggling to find power in his injured leg. More than likely he will miss the majority of 2026, and its possible he will not see the field again until 2027.

news.body: Wan'Dale Robinson caught three of seven targets for 22 yards in the Titans' 26-20 win over the Colts on Sunday.
news.head: Wan'Dale Robinson snags three passes in win
news.impact: Robinson and Carnell Tate were the only pass catchers to catch more than one pass from Cam Ward on Sunday, and also the only two to go over 10 yards. Robinson has had some usable performances this year, but they seem to come on an every-other-week basis.

news.body: Wan'Dale Robinson caught 6-of-7 targets for 53 yards in the Titans 26-3 loss against the Texans on Sunday.
news.head: Wan'Dale Robinson leads Titans in receiving Sunday
news.impact: Robinson posted his third game with 50 yards on the season. He remains a WR3/ flex play next week against the Colts.

news.body: Wan'Dale Robinson caught 3-of-5 targets for 19 yards and a touchdown in the Titans loss to the Ravens.
news.head: Wan'Dale Robinson hauls in three passes in Week 4
news.impact: Robinson caught the lone touchdown pass from Cam Ward against the Ravens, giving Robinson a touchdown in back-to-back games. The 25-year-old will look to continue that streak in Week 5 against the Texans.

news.body: Wan'Dale Robinson caught 7-of-11 targets for 57 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 12-7 loss to the New York Giants.
news.head: Wan'Dale Robinson finds end zone Sunday
news.impact: Robinson played well against his former team on Sunday. He led the team in targets and receptions against the Giants, and he also scored the team's only touchdown over the course of the afternoon. Despite the good game, fantasy managers should not consider him a viable option moving forward.

news.body: Xavier Worthy caught seven passes for a team-high 73 yards in the Chiefs' 22-6 win over the Chargers in Week 6.
news.head: Xavier Worthy Leads Chiefs With 73 Receiving Yards in Week 6
news.impact: Worthy didn't find the end zone, but seven catches and a team-high 73 yards made him Kansas City's most productive receiver. The volume is the bigger takeaway here, with Rashee Rice out. Worthy remains one of Patrick Mahomes' top options and should stay in fantasy lineups going forward as a flex-- even when Rice returns.

news.body: Xavier Worthy caught four of his seven targets for 70 yards in a 30-27 win over the Raiders in Week 4.
news.head: Xavier Worthy goes for 70 yards in Week 4
news.impact: Worthy got some extra looks with Rashee Rice injuring his hamstring during the game. The veteran did most of his damage on a 41-yard catch from Patrick Mahomes II. With Week 4 being by far his best game of the season, Worthy will look to stay hot in Week 6 against the Chargers after his Week 5 bye.

news.body: Xavier Worthy caught both of his targets for 20 yards in the Chiefs' 24-10 Week 3 win over the Miami Dolphins.
news.head: Xavier Worthy quiet in Week 3 win
news.impact: Worthy was bottled up by a surprising Miami defensive effort Sunday, finishing with less than three receptions for the first time in three contests. The wideout has struggled to offer fantasy managers a reliable pass-catching option to begin the season, with a Week 4 contest against the Las Vegas Raiders up next.

news.body: Xavier Worthy caught 5-of-7 targets for 25 yards and a touchdown in Sunday night's 33-30 overtime win over the Indianapolis Colts.
news.head: Xavier Worthy finds end zone in overtime win Sunday
news.impact: Worthy saw good involvement with seven targets on Sunday night, although he was only able to turn that into five catches for 25 yards against the Colts. He was able to score on one of those catches, however, which salvaged his night from a fantasy perspective. He should not be considered a strong option at the wide receiver position until we see some more consistent production from him.

news.body: Baltimore Ravens wide receiver Zay Flowers caught six passes for 66 yards on a season-high 11 targets in Week 6 against the Cleveland Browns.
news.head: Zay Flowers logs season-high 11 targets in Week 6
news.impact: Flowers' weekly floor has been impressive this season, recording at least 50 yards in every contest this season. It was his second game with double-digit targets in a concentrated passing attack that has been successful this season. When Lamar Jackson returns, Flowers has a higher ceiling, having failed to reach the end zone in the last two weeks.

news.body: Zay Flowers (toe) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns.
news.head: Zay Flowers (toe) good to go for Sunday
news.impact: Baltimore's star wide receiver will be available to play on Sunday, despite still dealing with a minor toe injury of some kind. Fantasy managers shouldn't hesitate to start him this week, although his ceiling will be considerably lower than usual with QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) set to be sidelined for another week.

news.body: Zay Flowers (toe) was a limited participant at Baltimore's practice on Thursday.
news.head: Zay Flowers (toe) limited at practice Thursday
news.impact: Flowers is a new addition to Baltimore's injury report. He was limited at practice on Thursday after being a full participant on Wednesday, but this may just be a load management move on the part of the team. For now, fantasy managers should expect him to play in Week 6, although his projected output is likely to be lower than usual with QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) trending towards being sidelined again.

news.body: Zay Flowers came up with 8-of-9 targets for 53 yards in Sunday's 30-23 OT win over the Falcons.
news.head: Zay Flowers grabs eight passes for the second straight week
news.impact: Flowers now has 16 grabs on 19 targets over the last two weeks, as he remains a PPR mainstay for fantasy managers. He did miss a game back in Week 2, but in the four that he's played, the fourth-year receiver has averaged 6.5 receptions for more than 100 yards. Flowers is a WR2 at worst in standard fantasy formats right now.
